'''Trigo Shane''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] who lived during the [[Galactic War|renewed conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Corellia]], Trigo found himself hired as a consultant to Republic forced in the Government District of the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. Despite the protests of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bathens]], Trigo asked a Republic hero to grab Imperial weapons off of the vanguard fighters and destroy the Imperial hangar.
